dossier.headline: Realty leads the market on a pre-sales beat
dossier.summary: Realty was the standout sector on November 12, with Nifty Realty up 3.4% by midday and about 4% at the close. Oberoi, Sobha and Lodha rose about 5% intraday, and DLF neared its 52-week high, after Jefferies said September-quarter pre-sales beat its estimates for DLF, Oberoi, Godrej Properties and Prestige.
why_it_matters: Realty was the top sector in an otherwise flat market
The Nifty Realty index is up 14% so far in November
watch: Whether the rally holds in the next session
questions: Will other developers' pre-sales confirm the trend?
